title: WPMS/2306/2020 of SUSHANT MANDAL Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPMS No. 2306 of 2020
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Vikas Anand, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. T.S. Pharityal, Additional C.S.C. for
the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Lalit Sharma, Advocate for
respondent no. 4.
Heard learned counsel for the parties
through video conferencing.
By means of this writ petition,
petitioner has sought following relief:
1. To issue a writ, order or directions in the
nature of 'mandamus' by directing and
commanding the respondents to stay the
construction of the said road which is being
constructed in a very haphazard manner
without proper survey.

2. To issue a writ, order or directions in the
nature of 'mandamus' by directing and
commanding the respondents to construct
the road and drains as per the initial survey
as per the mandatory requirements of the GO
dated 15.10.2020.
The relief, as sought, cannot be
granted in writ petition. It is for the experts
to decide the alignment of the road.
Having regard to the facts and
circumstances of the case, the writ petition
is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to
make representation to the Competent
Authority / respondent. If such
representation is made within ten days from
today, the same shall be decided within six
weeks from the date of production of
certified copy of this order.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
Aswal 05.12.2020
